title: Bend with ButACake @ GreenStop
description: Hosted by ButACake and GreenStopGreenstop Dispensary516 Tonnelle Ave, Jersey City, Join us for Bend with ButACake — Spread Love Edition at GreenStop Dispensary!A chill, inclusive evening of yoga, connection, and tasty ButACake vibes. Come move, meet people, and leave feeling cozy. What to expect: light flow suitable for all levels, short breathwork, and a chance to snag limited merch.?To enter the merch grab, stop into GreenStop and purchase any ButACake item before the event. We’ll select 3 winners for limited merch grabs from those who purchased.Bring a mat, bring a friend, bring your energy. Can’t wait to vibe and love!
dateNote: the date shown on the page is the WordPress publish date (YOOtheme post meta), not necessarily the event date
